display.purpose: The name heading at the top of the card. One use, one element.

title.purpose: Expanded project card heading. Second appearance of a display-scale type.

body.purpose: Bio paragraph. Max 72ch. The only place Inter appears in the system.

label.purpose: Skill category names, cert pill text, any uppercase identifier.

mono.purpose: Project names, social links, terminal lines, chrome labels. Default for all new UI text.

shadows.name: card-ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Main card only. Cold-signal ambient halo + deep black drop shadow. Not used on any inner element.

motion.name: ease-card-enter
motion.purpose: Card entrance only. Deceleration curve — arrives fast, settles gently.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for view transitions and panel slides. Simple, unobtrusive.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Hover state transitions (color, border-color). Snappy — matches interaction speed.

motion.name: duration-hover-slow
motion.purpose: Hover transitions on larger elements (social links). Slightly slower for comfort.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single breakpoint. Below: single-column, full-viewport card, scrollable. Above: centered fixed card, two-column bottom split.

components.name: Main Card
components.description: The primary container. Full-bleed on mobile, max 1040px on desktop. Entrance animation on load.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(13,13,15,0.94); border: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.12); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(56,189,248,0.07), 0 0 80px rgba(56,189,248,0.05), 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); width: min(1040px, 100%); animation: ds-fadeUp 0.45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both; } @keyframes ds-fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { animation: none; } } .ds-card-body { padding: 32px 36px 28px; }

narrative.overview:
This system was not designed around a concept. It emerged from a series of functional decisions — use a dark background because it reduces glare, use a monospaced font because it's native to the work, use one accent because one is enough — and the aesthetic is what's left after those decisions compound. That's its character: not minimalism as a stance, but minimalism as a consequence.

The result reads like a terminal you'd actually use. Not terminal-as-costume: no scanline overlays, no fake typing effects, no green-on-black nostalgia. The grid is there because a grid is structurally useful. The mono is primary because the person who built this lives in mono. The accent fires only where information is being communicated — a live link, a category, a hover state. Everywhere else, it holds.

What this system explicitly rejects: SaaS landing-page conventions (hero metrics, gradient cards, buzzword copy), over-animated portfolios (parallax, cursor effects, particle fields), warm-neutral palettes applied for warmth, and decorative elements that earn their place only by looking designed.
keyCharacteristics: Square everywhere — no border radius at any scale
JetBrains Mono as the primary voice; Inter only for prose; Bebas Neue only for the name
Text hierarchy built from opacity and weight, not hue
Motion is state-driven — it communicates change, it doesn't perform
Density is high; white space is earned, not defaulted

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cold Signal (#38bdf8) is the only chromatic color in the system. It may not be introduced as a fill, a gradient component, or a background tint. Its function is signal: label, border, state indicator.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Text hierarchy is expressed through Ghost Text → Dim Prompt → Screen Gray alone. No additional text colors, no blues or greens for emphasis. Bold in Inter is the only in-body emphasis mechanism.

rules.name: The Three-Font Cap Rule
rules.body: The system uses exactly three typefaces: Bebas Neue (display), JetBrains Mono (mono/UI), Inter (prose). No additions.

rules.name: The Mono Default Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the default choice for any new UI element. Inter is for prose blocks of three or more sentences. Bebas Neue is for the name only.

rules.name: The Flat Interior Rule
rules.body: No shadows inside the card. Elevation within the card is expressed through background tint and border opacity only.

dos: Do use Cold Signal (#38bdf8) only where something is interactive, live, or being labeled.
Do keep all corners square. No border-radius at any value, on any element.
Do default new UI text to JetBrains Mono. Use Inter only for prose blocks of three or more sentences.
Do express text hierarchy through Ghost Text → Dim Prompt → Screen Gray. No additional text colors.
Do keep transitions at 0.15–0.18s for hover states.
Do ensure body text (Inter, 15px, #888 on #0d0d0f) meets 4.5:1 contrast.
Do use @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to instant-switch any transform or opacity animation.
donts: Don't introduce Cold Signal as a background fill, gradient component, or decorative tint.
Don't use warm neutrals or tinted backgrounds.
Don't add border-radius to any element.
Don't add shadows inside the card.
Don't use SaaS landing-page conventions: no hero metrics, no gradient cards, no eyebrow labels above every section, no numbered section markers, no buzzword copy.
Don't animate layout properties. Transitions are on color, border-color, and opacity only.
Don't use all-caps for anything longer than a short label.
Don't make Ghost Text (#888) any lighter on a dark background — there's no contrast margin left.
